quest.name: Alcion's Hunt
quest.description: Alcion needs help containing the Stone Tarantula invasion in the region.

mission.name: Eliminate Tarantulas
mission.description: Kill 250 Stone Tarantulas and return to Alcion for your reward.

quest.name: Sewer Infestation
quest.description: Astro is suffering from an Earth Beetle infestation in the sewer in front of his house.

mission.name: Exterminate Earth Beetles
mission.description: Kill 150 Earth Beetles in the sewer and return to Astro for your reward.

quest.name: Katata's Honey
quest.description: Katata had his honey hive stolen by mud bees and needs it back so he doesn't starve.

mission.name: Recover the Mud Hive
mission.description: Find the Mud Hive in the mud bees' den and return it to Katata.

quest.name: Lion Extermination
quest.description: Tong Lee found the lion sanctuary, but doesn't care about the sanctuary: he just wants to exterminate all the lions.

mission.name: Exterminate the Lions
mission.description: Kill 300 Ba Sing Se Lions in the sanctuary and return to Tong Lee for your reward.

quest.name: John's Feather
quest.description: John makes clothing from animal items and needs an earth woodpecker feather for his next creation.

mission.name: Deliver the Feather
mission.description: Get an earth woodpecker feather and deliver it to John.

quest.name: Rogerio's Photos
quest.description: Rogerio was photographing landscapes when an Earth Mordecai stole all his photos. Help recover them (level 115+).

mission.name: Recover the stolen photos
mission.description: Kill Earth Mordecai to recover the 3 stolen photos and return them to Rogerio.

quest.name: Traitor Massacre
quest.description: A strange man stole Felipinho's lollipop money and even punched him. Massacre this man's family, the Traitors, and recover the 100k gold.

mission.name: Massacre the Traitor's family
mission.description: Kill 800 Traitors and return to Felipinho with 100k gold to receive a piece of the Traitor Set (your choice).

quest.name: Mountain Defender's Treasure
quest.description: Aiano was climbing the mountain when he found a huge white monster, the Mountain Defender, who guards a treasure. Defeat it and steal a piece of the treasure.

mission.name: Steal the guardian's treasure
mission.description: Defeat the Mountain Defender, take the treasure chest and return to Aiano to choose a piece of the Mountain Set.

quest.name: Margarida's Rabbit
quest.description: Mrs. Margarida's rabbit ran away in fear and entered the stone-spitting spiders' den. Rescue it and return it to her.

mission.name: Rescue the rabbit
mission.description: Find Margarida's Rabbit in the stone-spitting spiders' den, say rescue and return to Mrs. Margarida.

quest.name: Bear Invasion
quest.description: Joana is being bothered by fierce bears trying to invade her house. Hunt 150 of them and earn a gift.

mission.name: Eliminate fierce bears
mission.description: Kill 150 fierce bears and return to Joana for your reward.

quest.name: Rafinha's Ring
quest.description: Rafinha lost his dad's ring in the lake where they usually fish and asks for help to recover it before his dad returns.

mission.name: Get the ring in the lake
mission.description: Fish at the marked lake spot to find the shark ring and return to Rafinha.

quest.name: Stolen Cabbages
quest.description: A troublemaker stole the Lord of Cabbages' cabbages and scattered them around the city. Click the cabbages on the ground to recover them (level 1+).

mission.name: Recover the stolen cabbages
mission.description: Find and click the 50 cabbages scattered around the city. Return to the Lord of Cabbages for rewards at each level reached (1, 10, 20, 35 and 50 cabbages).

quest.name: Carlos' Carapace
quest.description: Carlos is a blacksmith who needs steel carapaces from centipedes to forge guard armor.

mission.name: Collect Steel Carapaces
mission.description: Kill 200 Steel Shell Centipedes and return to Carlos for your reward.

quest.name: Haroldo's Mistake
quest.description: Haroldo was a teacher who studied forbidden texts and accidentally freed knowledge that came to life.

mission.name: Destroy Forbidden Books
mission.description: Kill 2500 Forbidden Folds Books and return to Haroldo for your reward.

quest.name: The Colonel's Revenge
quest.description: A retired colonel lost his battalion to a horde of vulture bees in the desert and now wants revenge.

mission.name: Hunt Vulture Bees
mission.description: Kill 300 Vulture Bees and return to Colonel Fuligem for your reward.

quest.name: Lumina's Cave
quest.description: Lumina found a cave full of gleaming beetles, but they are blocking the entrance.

mission.name: Clear the Cave
mission.description: Kill 100 Gleaming Beetles in the cave and return to Lumina for your reward.

quest.name: Mrs. Fofinha's Garden
quest.description: Mrs. Fofinha planted a huge garden and the elephants are destroying everything.

mission.name: Protect the Garden
mission.description: Kill 150 Elephants and return to Mrs. Fofinha for your reward.

quest.name: Rosalinda's Cemetery
quest.description: Rosalinda lost her grandmother's favorite toy in the cemetery and the worms are eating everything.

mission.name: Clear the Cemetery
mission.description: Kill 100 Cemetery Worms and return to Rosalinda for your reward.

quest.name: Coral's Beach
quest.description: Coral found a golden-shelled hermit crab on the beach and wants to protect the gentle hermits.

mission.name: Protect the Crabs
mission.description: Kill 200 Hermit Crabs and return to Coral for your reward.

quest.name: Dr. Ferreira's Experiment
quest.description: Dr. Ferreira is a scientist who needs clay from mud men for an experiment in the laboratory.

mission.name: Collect Clay
mission.description: Kill 100 Mud Men and return to Dr. Ferreira for your reward.

quest.name: The River of Hippos
quest.description: Marcos takes care of the village river, but some hippos invaded and are attacking anyone who tries to pass.

mission.name: Contain the Hippos
mission.description: Kill 150 Hippos and return to Marcos for your reward.

quest.name: Jungle of Jaguars
quest.description: The jungle jaguars are becoming aggressive and attacking travelers.

mission.name: Hunt the Jaguars
mission.description: Kill 1000 Jaguars and return to Victor for your reward.

quest.name: Forbidden Knowledge
quest.description: A forbidden knowledge escaped and is creating uncontrolled beings everywhere.

mission.name: Contain the Chaos
mission.description: Kill 1500 Uncontrolled Knowledge and return to Silas for your reward.

quest.name: Shadow Panther
quest.description: The black panthers are hunting the forest animals and terrorizing the village.

mission.name: Hunt the Black Panthers
mission.description: Kill 2000 Black Panthers and return to Nair for your reward.

quest.name: Cockroach Plague
quest.description: The city temple is being invaded by cockroaches and Carla needs help exterminating them.

mission.name: Exterminate cockroaches
mission.description: Kill 50 Cockroaches and return to Carla for your reward.

quest.name: The Supplier
quest.description: Valdemira needs 150 hams to feed her animals. Deliver the hams and receive a generous experience reward.

mission.name: Deliver 150 Ham
mission.description: Bring 150 hams to Valdemira. Requirement: level 200+.
